description: Open-redirect cases for go-auth/login.LocalRedirect (column go) and js-components/router safeRedirectPath (column ts). Each column is the function's result, or null where it refuses the input. Both test suites load this file; the TypeScript one also checks, on every case, that whatever safeRedirectPath accepts LocalRedirect accepts too and that both results lead to the same place. A case whose columns differ must say why in note.

cases.name: dot-dot segment
cases.note: Dot segments resolved. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: single dot segment
cases.note: Dot segments resolved. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: encoded dot segment
cases.note: Browsers read %2e as a dot segment. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: dot-dot before a trailing slash and a query
cases.note: A trailing .. resolves to a trailing slash, not to "//", so the path is kept. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: dot-dot before a trailing slash and a fragment
cases.note: A trailing .. resolves to a trailing slash, not to "//", so the path is kept. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: dot-dot above the root
cases.note: A .. at the root stays at the root. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: trailing dot-dot
cases.note: A trailing .. at the root resolves to the root. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: space in the path
cases.note: The URL parser percent-encodes the space. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: non-ASCII path
cases.note: The URL parser percent-encodes non-ASCII as UTF-8. safeRedirectPath returns the path as the URL parser normalises it; LocalRedirect returns its input unchanged. Both lead to the same place.

cases.name: dot-dot above the root collapsing into //
